message: 冬の到来

name: Synn
message: 「Gah?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Sakura-kun, is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-H-H-H-Hello!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, hello.」
Running into Melilot-san somewhere other than the library really caught me off guard.
Figuring she must be offended by my blatantly startled reaction, I hurriedly greet her.
Melilot-san is fundamentally a woman of few words.
Not out of ill humor, though--she simply seemed unsure how to interact with boys and girls our age.
Then, a few months after first getting my library card, I finally noticed: Melilot-san favors students who greet her properly.

name: Synn
message: 「Nice weather we're having, isn't it?」
I stick to safe, neighborly small talk.

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed it is.」
A conversation hit-by-pitch.

name: Synn
message: 「Every year we get long autumn rains, yet for some reason, sunny days just keep going this year.」
Another pitch.

name: Melilot
message: 「Fascinating, isn't it. The autumn rains were unusually brief, and as if in their place, there have been so many shooting stars...」
This time, I'm the one who failed to catch the ball.
How am I supposed to respond to that?
From the time I enrolled at Ryuusei Academy until I was elected Student Council president, Melilot-san showed me only the bare minimum of kindness.
Of course, it wasn't because she recognized me as one of her own, but simply the kindness a school librarian extends to the entire student body.
Lately, however, I feel like that has begun to change.

name: Melilot
message: 「The shape of the clouds has changed.」
Melilot-san looks up at the sky, and I follow her gaze.

name: Melilot
message: 「The sound of the wind rustling the trees has grown louder, too. It is the beginning of winter.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, the cold winter sea breeze feels great.」
The blue sky is refreshing to the eyes.
This feeling is... much like the crisp, unburdened refreshment of finishing a good book.

name: Melilot
message: 「You can see the ocean from this hilltop, can't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Long ago, every fisherman in Ryuusei Town would head out to sea wearing a one-of-a-kind sweater knitted by their spouse, or so the story goes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hand-knitted, huh. Sounds warm.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. It is wisdom so that even if a husband returns to port as a drowned corpse, he can still be properly identified.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, can you tell your companions apart?」

name: Synn
message: 「I can!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, huh!?」
I lowered my gaze from the sky to answer, only to find no one there.

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're looking for the shut-in, she already headed off to the library. She did say goodbye while you were lost in thought, Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh」
I thought Melilot-san's behavior had been changing lately, but was I just being self-conscious?
